verdict.rationale: Unit's docs say the platform can send and receive money over wires and real-time payments, with settlement-level visibility. It also claims direct Federal Reserve connectivity as a registered Fed service provider, which suggests faster-rail origination and receipt through one platform. However, FedNow is never named, RTP is implied only by the generic phrase "real-time payments", and no per-rail capability documentation appears; the OpenAPI probes returned 404. Missing for 10: explicit FedNow support, explicit RTP network naming, per-rail capability and limit documentation, API-level proof that all rails share the same endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.
